Overview.Name: Madhava Rao Gadiyapudi
Overview.Goal: Reduce weight, improve BP control, and keep energy consistent through the day with appearance, confidence, health, and stress reduction focus.

Main_Meal_Lunch_or_Dinner: Chicken curry with minimal oil + rice (small portion) + cooked vegetables
OR Fish fry pan fried in ghee + rice + carrot or beans
OR Boiled eggs (3 to 4) + dal + cooked vegetables
OR Egg curry + rice + spinach or cabbage
Light_Snacks_Only_If_Hungry: Puffed rice with onion and salt
OR One seasonal fruit (banana, apple, papaya)

Notes_and_Tips: For BP: limit pickles, papad, bakery foods, and anything very salty.
Avoid all fried items since they trigger overeating and affect BP.
Keep meals slow cooked or pan fried with minimal oil for BP control.
Eat vegetables daily to improve fullness and digestion.
Since you eat only one meal, drink water through the day and avoid long gaps with no fluids.
Social gatherings: eat protein first (chicken, fish, eggs) before touching rice or snacks.
Yoga is excellent. Add short walks after your meal to help BP control.
Stick to the same routine daily to match your preference for a fixed structure.
Focus heavily on protein and clean fats to keep you full throughout the day.
Keep oil low and avoid deep fried items because of high BP management needs.
